last_action.summary: Implemented B1-M2-P1. Inspection (verified live 2026-09-07) settled the schema: one authoritative series (WDFW + Muckleshoot at the Ballard Locks ladder), so the constraint is (date, species) with source as provenance -- strengthened by finding that the two retrieval routes OVERLAP on current-season sockeye, so keying on source would double-count one observation. Found an undocumented JSON feed behind the page's chart (pssp-count.wdfw-fish.us) carrying 17 seasons of daily sockeye in one download. Four findings that change downstream plans: Chinook/coho have NO obtainable multi-year daily history (sockeye ~15 sound years vs one season for the other two, so M3's baseline for those rests on a single year); the JSON's count_Nyear keys are relative to the current year, not calendar (verified by matching the 2017/2013 spikes against the independent annual table); blank cells are pre-rendered for the whole season and must not be read as zero; multi-day range rows exist and cannot be stored. Recent-window question dissolved -- the source serves the full season in one document and warns counts are revised, so re-parse the whole season every run. Built apps/salmon with both models, three DB-level constraints verified in the DDL (unique (date,species), closed species vocabulary, correction-note-required), admin for both, 24 tests passing, makemigrations --check clean, migrate verified on a genuinely fresh DB. Corrected two prior assumptions: steelhead is not published at this ladder (no vocabulary member created; the SALMON_SPECIES subset structure retained and the affected DECISIONS entry annotated to avoid a standing contradiction), and the source gives a per-row Running Total, enabling a per-date parser checksum rather than a season-end one. Commit a709172 on feat/salmon-ballard-locks (not pushed). Full pytest suite deliberately NOT run -- deferred to milestone end per human direction mid-phase; caveat recorded in thread since this phase did touch settings.py and urls.py, both covered by a passing manage.py check. STATUS.md skipped (status_updates=pm_only). P1 is not the last phase and code_review=every_milestone, so routing to PM.StatusUpdate.

context.goal: A small mobile-first website that answers whether salmon are currently visible at Ballard Locks and forecasts total salmon expected over the next 7 days, combining crowd YES/NO reports with locally stored official/historical fish-count data.
notes: STATE is the routing source of truth.
